title: Move the governed lifecycle one step at a time, each step by its authority

assertions.name: the designer cannot approve the design (403: room.design.approve)
one governed step at a time: PLANNED → COMMISSIONING is refused (422)
the systems engineer approves the design (DESIGN_APPROVED)
the installer cannot open the installation window (403: window.approve)
the operations lead approves the installation window (INSTALLATION_PENDING)
the installer cannot start commissioning (403: plan.compile)
the device register gates commissioning: refused (422) while units still need registering, with the positions named
the installer registers every unit (serial; hostname and IP for networked units): the register is complete
the room is COMMISSIONING, the approved revision is 2, every applicable test is NOT_TESTED and needs physical execution

recording the installation put one physical unit at every non-furniture position — identity UNKNOWN, no serial, no maker — recorded by the installer (ADR-0012); the register then declared each serial (14 Nov 2026)
